plan.question: Can a source-time exponential kernel represent uncertain free RC responses and every likelihood cross term more accurately without changing the rolling solver?
plan.scope: Stationary fabricated representation diagnostic, no optimizer, truth, aging, causal learning run or target qualification.

fixed.queries: Same97local/129full saved points. No retuning of support, noise, observed values or other response bases.

kernel.pivot: c_i=sqrt(lambda_min*lambda_max), lambda=1/tau; public or frozen local support only
kernel.functions: b_n(t)=exp(-c*t)*L_n(2*c*t); beta_0=b_0, beta_n=b_n-b_(n-1); exp(-lambda*t)=sum_n z^n beta_n(t)
kernel.truncation: Use n=0..K-1; beta_0(0)=1 and beta_n(0)=0 for n>0, preserving the physical entering value. No fitted centers or history weighting.
kernel.uniform_exact_arithmetic_bound: |a-a_K|<=rho^K/(1-rho), all t>=0, from the Cayley right-half-plane map, bounded analytic exponential on the unit disk, and Cauchy coefficient estimates. Numeric bound endpoints not machine certified.
kernel.translation: beta_n(t+s)=sum_(j=0)^n beta_j(t)*beta_(n-j)(s). Truncated coefficient convolution composes exactly in R[z]/(z^K), not by multiplying decoded scalar approximations.
kernel.endpoint: Return exact free RC endpoint from elapsed time and queried tau; track historical residual approximation separately. Forced RC and hysteresis endpoint use inherited basis.
kernel.mixed_terms: Emit complete joint normalized residual rows, replacing selected free RC columns only; retain cross terms through QR. Query analytic derivatives in all original16coordinates and GN from residual Jacobians.

controls.matched_log_basis: Selectively interpolate free exp(-t/tau) on K fixed log-tau Chebyshev nodes. K5 must reproduce predecessor free columns, apart from recurrence rounding. Same number of free columns as time kernel.
controls.raw_exact_free: Exact selected free components at each stored observation, diagnostic lower-error control only; no bounded representation claim.
controls.time_composition: t=[0,.01,.1,1,10,120],s=[0,.03,2,30], all model pivots; compare direct beta(t+s) to truncated convolution and two merge trees.
controls.initial_value: Every selected kernel exactly has a_K(0)=1 in mathematical arithmetic; verify query/derivative behavior.
controls.cross_terms: Direct rows vs full QR cost,gradient,GN; partitioned and merged global-coordinate QR controls.
controls.query_derivatives: Central finite differences at public mean, delta=1e-5publicSD, scaled allowance1e-5.
controls.reference: Independent original recurrence versus saved C cost/endpoint on all queries; inherited2e-10 relative,2e-8 absolute numerical allowances.
controls.finite_mismatches: Record and continue; no tolerance relaxation; hard source/domain/nonfinite errors stop.
controls.cancellation: Public-mean zero represented residual control at4096/local/time_kernel/K9/all_three; QR versus direct squared residuals; no clipping.

memory.full_factor: F=75 + selected_modes*(K-5), packed double QR F(F+1)/2
memory.boundary: Original forced/hysteresis node boundary, plus authoritative elapsed time; selected exact free endpoint needs no past samples. Conservative ledger retains inherited node state.
memory.source_state: Original identity,domain,estimate andownership reservations preserved. Add elapsed time and3kernel pivots=32B conservatively.
memory.scratch: Previous query reservation with expandedF and max extra kernel/query scratch 8*(4*K+16), no unproved aliasing.
memory.limits: Complete prospective allocation, not measured C/M23 footprint; static transforms in program ROM are allowed, historical data remain SRAM-only.

plan.decision: Report continuous error, component attribution, uniform free-response bound and full memory/work tradeoff. Historical0.1NLL remains descriptive, not a universal physical gate. Do not select a degree after seeing results.
